The '''Ismaren parents''' were members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] with two [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] children [[Lagan Ismaren|Lagan]] and [[Roganda Ismaren/Legends|Roganda]]. The children were separated from their parents shortly after they fled their sanctuary on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]].<ref name="The Emperor's Pawns">{{GamerCite|5|The Emperor's Pawns}}</ref>
